Vote: Grandview Highway and Southeast Marine social housing
Description: Approved two six-storey buildings providing 136 social-housing homes with supports.
Move to reverse 2022 plan for Brodway "Great Street" with a bike lane.
Outcome Details: Money saved was not spent on adding cycling infrastructure elsewhere.

Determines whether residents can remain in temporary modular housing until replacement homes exist.
Sets the speed limit on a high-risk corridor beside Kitsilano Beach.
Creates a plan to maintain lane markings, crosswalks, and safety paint.
Removes required minimum off-street parking in major west-side areas.

Determines whether Vancouver seeks more speed and red-light cameras.

Sets a new direction for the future design and operation of Kitsilano Pool.

Shapes how parks and recreation services could move under direct Council oversight.

Requires an updated road-safety strategy with clearer targets and accountability.

Expedites a flashing crosswalk after a serious collision at 16th and Willow.

Description: Considers simpler, safer temporary street closures for Halloween block parties.

Outcome Details: Referred for changes instead of approving the initiative
